high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore feed, showcasing a brass dome pendant light. The product is displayed prominently in the center of the image, with a detailed view of its design. The light fixture features a polished brass finish on the upper part, which transitions into a textured, aged copper or patina finish on the dome-shaped shade. The craftsmanship appears intricate, with multiple layers and a smooth, elegant transition between materials. Below the image, there is a "Shop Now" button, indicating that the item can be purchased directly from the platform.
